headline: PASTABench reports weak optimal-timing performance in proactive agent-safety monitoring
summary: The authors introduce PASTABench, a paper-reported benchmark of 1,139 synthesized multi-turn agent trajectories across five risk categories and thirteen subcategories, with human-checked Earliest-Signal and Trigger turns defining an Optimal Intervention Window. In their evaluation of 16 language models, the paper reports that GPT-4o reached 40.74% Perfect timing and 68.22% On-Time interventions. The authors also report sensitivity to explicit hazard vocabulary in open-weight models. These are benchmark results on constructed trajectories, not evidence of deployed-agent safety or real-world harm reduction; independent reproduction remains open.
